title: The Axiomatic Breach
description: Break every law of physics and mathematics at once, and step through the hole. Unlocks the Axiomatic Breach Engine and the Axiom Key.

puzzle.goal: A sphere of radius R holds matter whose energy density falls from u0 at the centre to zero at the edge as 1 − r²/R². No region can hold more than a fixed amount of information, proportional to its radius times its total energy. Write that maximum, in bits, with the energy built up from thin spherical shells.
puzzle.name: Bekenstein bound
puzzle.ask: The integral is 8πρ0c²R³/15. For a proton-sized region (R in fm, u = ρ0c² in MeV/fm³, ħc in MeV fm) find the maximum information.
puzzle.method: Total energy is the volume integral of the energy density over shells 4πr²dr; the entropy bound is 2πkRE/(ħc), and dividing by kB ln 2 converts to bits.
